annotation.venue: e-Gov Law Search (Act No. 105 of 1960, consolidated as amended by Act No. 52 of 2026)
annotation.summary_en: This is the consolidated text of Japan's Road Traffic Act (1960), current as of the July 2026 amendment. Most of it governs ordinary road traffic. It also regulates remote-operated small vehicles such as delivery robots: operators must notify the authorities, display markings and give way to pedestrians. A permit system covers "specified automated operation", meaning driverless Level 4 autonomous driving.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines remote-operated small vehicles (遠隔操作型小型車), which must have an emergency stop device and be treated as pedestrians when using the road.
Users of remote-operated small vehicles must notify the Public Safety Commission, display a notification number, and accept reports and inspections.
Remote operators must operate reliably at safe speeds and give way to pedestrians; police may stop or move a hazardous unit.
Defines 'specified automated operation' using an automated operation device without a driver, and sets up a permit regime for it (Chapter 4-3, Arts. 75-12 to 75-29).
Sets criminal penalties and a fixed-fine (反則金) system for traffic violations.
